## Mapping Decisions

- The source already arrives in Senzing JSON; the mapping routes values verbatim (verbatim check passes).
- RECORD_TYPE comes from each record's own FEATURES.RECORD_TYPE (PERSON on all 30).
- Record 2171 keeps both names: NAME_TYPE PRIMARY (Whitfield) and AKA (Reyes).
- DATE_OF_BIRTH is M/D/YYYY in the source and kept verbatim.
- Record 3048's REL_ANCHOR (domain REFERENCE) is kept: CORE_BANKING 3050 holds the matching REL_POINTER (role Carer). The analyzer's anchor-without-pointer error is file-scoped and was accepted with --rel-explanation naming that pointer.
- FILE_STATUS and FILE_SINCE are payload; neither collides with a reserved attribute.
